product.title: FROM FLORIDA: Bahamas Day Escape By Ferry

description.text: Escape to paradise with a day trip to the Bahamas, home to more than 700 islands in the Atlantic. Depart from Port Everglades in Fort Lauderdale and ride a high-speed ferry to either Bimini Island or Grand Bahama. Spend the afternoon enjoying beaches, island atmosphere, and optional activities before returning to Florida the same day.

highlights: Enjoy a round-trip ferry ride to the Bahamas with a guaranteed seat
Spend an afternoon on Bimini Island or Grand Bahama Island
Relax on warm-water beaches with turquoise ocean views
All port fees and taxes are included

start.description: Port Everglades, 1850 Eller Dr, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316, USA. Arrive early for check-in and customs processing.

itineraryItems.title: Check-in at Port Everglades
itineraryItems.description: Meet at Port Everglades in Fort Lauderdale, complete check-in, and board the ferry.

itineraryItems.title: Ferry crossing to the Bahamas
itineraryItems.description: Cruise to Bimini Island or Grand Bahama with onboard seating and amenities.

itineraryItems.title: Free time on the island
itineraryItems.description: Enjoy about 5 to 6 hours onshore for beaches, dining, and optional activities.

itineraryItems.title: Return sailing to Florida
itineraryItems.description: Board the ferry in the evening and return to Port Everglades.

additionalInfo: Pickup may be available depending on booking option
Activities on the island are optional and not included

faqs.question: Where does the ferry depart?
faqs.answer: The departure point is Port Everglades at 1850 Eller Dr, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316.

faqs.question: How long is the tour?
faqs.answer: The full experience is approximately 12 hours, including ferry time and island free time.

faqs.question: What is included in the price?
faqs.answer: Your fare includes round-trip ferry transportation, a guaranteed seat, and all listed port fees and taxes.
